translationRepairs: The Three Dynasties could hand down sound policies on public finance, yet they could not keep later ages from the abuses those policies invite.
The Three Kings could hand down sound policies on public finance, yet they could not keep later ages from the abuses those policies invite.
s0004 has 三王, the Three Kings; 三代 would be the Three Dynasties. Replacing Dynasties with Kings restores the correct referent.

With the river frontier under alert and beacons firing, Jiqing Army Military Commissioner Handa said: "Bozhou once had sixty thousand households; since the southern withdrawal they could not bear the levies and fled—fewer than one in ten remain; below the Dang Mountains the countryside is deserted!"

With the river frontier under alert and beacons firing, Jiqing Army Military Commissioner Wendihanda said: "Bozhou once had sixty thousand households; since the southern withdrawal they could not bear the levies and fled—fewer than one in ten remain; below the Dang Mountains the countryside is deserted!"
s0253 names 溫蒂罕達 in full; truncating to Handa invents a shortened personal name not given in the Chinese.
In the eighth month of Mingchang's third year the emperor asked the Ministry of Revenue: "People do not store in good years and starve in bad—what policy will make them value grain and store more?"

In the eighth month of Mingchang's third year an edict to the Department of State Affairs said: "People do not store in good years and starve in bad—what policy will make them value grain and store more?"
s0222 has 敕尚書省, an edict to the Department of State Affairs; the idiomatic wrongly turns this into a question asked of the Ministry of Revenue (戶部).

In the eighth month of the third year of Mingchang, an edict to the Ministry of Revenue: "When the people are in abundant harvest they do not strive to store; at one encounter with famine they immediately face blocked hunger—what method can make the people value grain and store more?"

In the eighth month of the third year of Mingchang, an edict to the Department of State Affairs: "When the people are in abundant harvest they do not strive to store; at one encounter with famine they immediately face blocked hunger—what method can make the people value grain and store more?"
s0222 addresses 尚書省 (Department of State Affairs), not 尚書戶部; the literal's Ministry of Revenue is the wrong office.
In Cheng'an's first year the ministry reported: "Reassessment was due in the ninth month that year, but could not be completed due to circumstances."
In Cheng'an's first year the Department of State Affairs reported: "Reassessment was due in the ninth month that year, but could not be completed due to circumstances."
s0225 has 尚書省奏; naming the Department of State Affairs corrects the vague and inaccurate "the ministry."
In the first year of Cheng'an, the Ministry of Revenue reported: "That year reassessment was due in the ninth month, but because of circumstances could not be completed."
In the first year of Cheng'an, the Department of State Affairs reported: "That year reassessment was due in the ninth month, but because of circumstances could not be completed."
s0225's reporter is 尚書省, the Department of State Affairs, not the Ministry of Revenue.

In Taihe's intercalary twelfth month the emperor noted that reassessment crammed floating wealth, property, and prior rankings into a rushed deadline and ordered the Ministry of Revenue to adopt ongoing collection: from then on sales followed the trade, separate registers were kept, and only floating wealth was adjusted at census time.

In Taihe's intercalary twelfth month the emperor noted that reassessment crammed floating wealth, property, and prior rankings into a rushed deadline and ordered the Department of State Affairs to adopt ongoing collection: from then on sales followed the trade, separate registers were kept, and only floating wealth was adjusted at census time.
s0234 has 敕尚書省; the addressee is the Department of State Affairs, not the Ministry of Revenue.

In the intercalary twelfth month of the second year of Taihe, the emperor said that during reassessment, since both floating wealth and property were questioned and prior rankings checked, the deadline pressed and affairs multiplied, hard to obtain truth—he ordered the Ministry of Revenue to fix a method of timely reassessment collection for household property: from now pawned or sold estates follow the trade in collection; separate registers set; at the time only floating wealth and property bound for increase or decrease.

In the intercalary twelfth month of the second year of Taihe, the emperor said that during reassessment, since both floating wealth and property were questioned and prior rankings checked, the deadline pressed and affairs multiplied, hard to obtain truth—he ordered the Department of State Affairs to fix a method of timely reassessment collection for household property: from now pawned or sold estates follow the trade in collection; separate registers set; at the time only floating wealth and property bound for increase or decrease.
s0234's 尚書省 is the Department of State Affairs; Ministry of Revenue misidentifies the office receiving the edict.

In Taihe's twelfth month of the fourth year, officials serving afar often left family property improperly assessed; real estate sales were collected promptly, and families without floating wealth could petition ward and village assemblies for verified exemption.

In Taihe's twelfth month of the fourth year, the emperor said officials serving afar often left family property improperly assessed; real estate sales were collected promptly, and families without floating wealth could petition ward and village assemblies for verified exemption.
s0235 begins 上以…遂定; the emperor is the explicit agent of the policy, and the idiomatic omission drops that subject.
